references.notes: 81-7-27, 81-7-28 (partly BM 46276-46534). One case from Assyria and one from “Babylon,” according to a notice of dispatch, P 2286, dated 30 April 1881. No record of receipt at BM located. Essentially the date-number 81-7-27 was allocated to the Assyrian material, but 81-7-27, 200-205, 209-210, and 212-213, are registered as from Babylon. All of 81-7-28 are registered as from Babylon. Work was also proceeding nearby at Ibrahim al-Khalil and possibly at Dailem.
